auditKind: fresh independent diagnostic assertion audit; runtime phases aborted

verdictPolicy.pass: Only a complete source-verifiable obligation can pass when fresh runtime is unavailable.
verdictPolicy.fail: An unambiguous contradiction in the completed source; runtime reproduction remains separately not-run.
verdictPolicy.not-run: Required runtime/native/scale precondition unavailable, or historical evidence cannot prove this full assertion.
verdictPolicy.historicalReceipts: Supplemental, never silently upgraded to fresh passing evidence.
